name: Katakura Kojuro
source:
"Even if there is no happiness for you by my side, is it still alright?"

The "Dragon's Right-hand Man", who has been supporting Masamune since he was a child. Katakura Kojuro is a loyal and reliable adult. He also has a surprising side to him——?

Temperament: Nostalgic and mischievous
Likes: Oshiruko

[Information taken from the official character profile.]
